intentional_core_evolution.reason: Deterministic live-current routing: high-confidence freshness requests force authorized web.current.search before model synthesis and guard false no-live-access replies.
Bounded five-second JWT leeway for Google iat clock skew without weakening signature/audience/issuer/expiry checks.

E2E hardening: replaced the fixed four-round tool-call limit with independent bounded controls (model rounds/operations/wall-time/duplicate suppression) and a mandatory tools-disabled final synthesis (app/assistant.py); optional max_tokens passthrough for task-appropriate response budgets, backward-compatible via a signature probe (app/model.py); durable-evidence injection, per-conversation active project, and tool-schema-aware context budgeting (app/context.py); messages.status terminal-state vocabulary widened via a detected, idempotent table rebuild, plus active-subject evolution, per-conversation project binding, and durable evidence storage (app/database.py). stream_chat's protected contract changed only to read the new orchestrator terminal-state fields and persist them; its request/response shape and streaming behavior are unchanged.

protected_core.hash_notes: Protected core hashes are measured from the Windows operator working tree. Recently edited core files (app/assistant.py, app/auth.py, app/model.py, app/context.py, app/database.py) use CRLF on disk; unchanged core files remain LF and keep their original freeze hashes.
